comment: The maker's site is dead, so menu item names were read out of the installed 2.1.4 build's appendContextMenu code. Stereo Mixer has DC block and nothing else; the two CV-controlled mixers have DC block, Show CV pan attenuators, and Copy Scene and Paste Scene under a SCENES: label. Every one of them prints with a trailing space, colon and space before its checkmark, which the lines drop. Stereo Mixer builds eight LedDisplayTextField widgets and saves their contents as text 1 to text 8 in the patch, which is what the name-field note rests on; neither of the other two mixers has them.
